Name: JP's Le Pets - Terrapets - Terraria Pets
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#ffff00][u][center]Terrapets[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]


[color=#00ff00][size=5][i]You can adopt cats, dogs, rabbits and, extra special, the zoologist. [/i][/size][/color]

[size=4]All pets have better statistics than the ones you can normally adopt at Marnie's ranch. They cost less gold, require less hearts and are more likely to give you a gift. 
Due to the nature of 2D Min... err Terraria, the amount of animations these pets can do is very limited, but they can still be enjoyed without any problems. [/size]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ffff00][size=6][b][u][i]In order to adopt you must do one of these two options:[/i][/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/list][list=1]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b]Reach 5 hearts with the pet Marnie finds.[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][color=#f4f4f4]Rejects the pet Marnie finds [/color]and[/b][/size][/font][font=Georgia][size=4][b] wait until day 2 of year 2 to receive a letter from her. [/b][/size][/font]
[/list][size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=4][b][i][color=#00ffff]Not much more to add, I hope you like it. [/color][/i][/b][/size]
